playwright._comment: The version is pinned rather than @latest: @latest downloads unknown code from the network on every start, so a new release reaches the developer environment without review and without a lock file record. The --browser chromium flag is mandatory: by default @playwright/mcp picks the Chrome channel, while this project only installs bundled chromium, and without the flag the browser_* tools fail with 'browser not found'. Bumping the version is a deliberate change through a commit.
